resolution_notes: auth_type: oauth2 (not apiKey). Auth0 Authentication API is OAuth 2.0/OIDC; Management API uses Bearer access tokens obtained via OAuth 2.0 client_credentials (M2M), not static API keys — docs: https://auth0.com/docs and https://auth0.com/docs/secure/tokens/access-tokens/get-management-api-access-tokens-for-production. example: original curl labeled YOUR_API_KEY is misleading; Management API expects a short-lived Bearer access token (YOUR_MGMT_API_TOKEN). Endpoint/shape confirmed at https://auth0.com/docs/api/management/v2. response_snippet kept as realistic list-users sample.
